recession_half_life_hours.source: Empirical urban drainage recession decay proxy
recession_half_life_hours.physical_interpretation: Time constant for surface water drainage/evaporation/infiltration loss after rainfall cessation

min_slope_threshold.physical_interpretation: Minimum slope floor to prevent division by zero in routing equations

ponding_concentration_factor.source: Topographic wetness index / depression convergence multiplier
ponding_concentration_factor.physical_interpretation: Amplification factor of excess runoff in low-lying terrain depressions

max_ponding_depth_cm.physical_interpretation: Maximum realistic flood depth threshold for surface nowcasting

cell_area_default_m2.source: USGS SRTM 1 Arc-Second (~30m x 30m grid at 13 deg N)
cell_area_default_m2.physical_interpretation: Nominal area of a single computational grid cell

drainage_mode.physical_interpretation: Spatial proximity diagnostic only; no fake hydraulic capacity subtraction
